Swinub

Ice Ground

Johto · Generation 2

Swinub is an Ice/Ground-type Pig Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 6.5 kg. It evolves into Piloswine. Its highest base stat is HP (50), with a base stat total of 250.
